note: I rated scratchpad/w18 (m01-m19) and w18q (q01, q11, q19), 930x575, built from 05d4cc2, and diffed every frame pixel by pixel against scratchpad/w17 and w17q (script raterA18/diff.py, difference maps raterA18/d_*.png, side-by-side pairs raterA18/p_*.png and zooms raterA18/z_*.png). The changes sit where the commit says: m05 (mean |diff| 2.6), m04 (2.5), m06, q11, m09, m01, m12, q19, m16, m03, m13 and m14. The large m11 diff (3.2) is the economy seatback screens, which belong to another area; no monument in it changed. m17 and q01 are pixel-identical. Sampling uses python3 + PIL, mean / p10 / p90 by luminance plus std over boxes (x0,y0,x1,y1); the script is raterA18/samp.py. This round fixes the one medium issue and most of the lows, and I found no regression. The welcome-glass wires are gone. The bar nosing is now a bright satin band that wraps both counter ends. The tumblers are dark glass with rims and edge glints. The monument ash has visible fine grain again, and the ash-wall flaps have rounded panels and symmetric full-length highlights. The remaining gaps are small. The ash grain is still about half the photo's relative contrast and shows a faint tile repeat on the large door-2 wall. The welcome pane now has no reflection cue at all. The tumbler glints are inset stripes rather than silhouette edges. The door-1 dark wood and the plain J lav doors are carried over unchanged. Lighting is noted but not scored: q19 still whites out the rear galley top, and the m01/m09 compartments are still washed out.

details.note: The bright satin nosing now wraps the counter ends, the door ash shows fine grain (std 5.1), and the tumblers are dark glass with rims. Small gaps remain. The nosing is a single flat band with no groove, the tumbler glints are inset stripes, and the end cheek grain is slightly coarse.

With the wire glints removed, the cabinet reads cleanly as smoked glass over shelves, and the D-boss latch, tag and head match omaat_room_32. The pane has no reflection cue, and the tag sits close to the head's top edge.

The rounded ash panels, symmetric full-length lit edges and darker clips now match lalf_133. The grain is visible but about half the photo's relative contrast, and it shows a faint repeat every 77 px on the tall wall. The frame corner radius is a little larger than in the photo.

issues.detail: Monument ash grain still low and faintly repeating (m04, q11, m16)
issues.problem: The new monoAsh layer brings the grain back, but its relative contrast is about half the photo's. On the 2 m tall door-2 wall a faint horizontal band pattern repeats about every 0.32 m (one tile).
issues.evidence: m04 (150,250,370,500) std 5.5 at L 197 (2.8 %), against lalf_133 (80,620,230,820) std 9.2 at L 159 (5.8 %). The row-profile autocorrelation of m04 x 470-520 peaks at 0.36 at a 77 px lag (raterA18/p_m04.png).
issues.fix: In 03_tex.js (shared, one line), raise PHOTO_GAIN[33] from 1.1 to about 1.6. Alternatively, in 10_mono.js give the ash wall alone a second material with the tile at a non-integer scale, for example LAYER_PARAMS[33] scale 3.1 to 2.3, to break the 77 px repeat. Aim for std 7-8 at m04.

issues.detail: Welcome pane has no reflection cue (m03, m16)
issues.problem: With the glints gone, the smoked pane is a uniform flat dark tone. omaat_room_32 shows a broad, soft, low-contrast sheen across the glass.
issues.evidence: The m03 pane is flat. In omaat_room_32 the pane brightens gently towards its upper left.
issues.fix: In buildWelcomeGalley in 10_mono.js, optionally add one pane-sized quad (cW - 0.1 by 0.67) 1 mm in front of the glass. Use Builder vertex colours with only the upper-left corner about 6-8 levels above the pane (#3a3837) and the rest at the pane tone (#2b292a). Do not add any edged strips.

issues.detail: Tumbler glints inset from the silhouette (m05, q11)
issues.problem: The two glassHi quads sit at x -0.016 and +0.014 on a 0.029 radius glass, so they read as two stripes on the face rather than edge highlights.
issues.evidence: raterA18/z_tumb.png: the stripes sit about a third of the way in. In samchui_render_11 the highlights hug the silhouettes.
issues.fix: In buildBar in 10_mono.js, move the glints to about ±0.025 and narrow them to 0.003. Better, place them relative to the camera-facing silhouette, or keep only the one on the light side.

issues.detail: Carry-over: door-1 dark wood streaks (q01, m19)
issues.problem: The fWood layer still shows radial streak aliasing at grazing angles, with a slightly mauve hue.
issues.fix: In 10_mono.js, lower the darkWood and darkWoodDoor grain amplitude or move them to a finer, lower-contrast layer, and warm the base towards #40352f.

issues.detail: Carry-over: plain J lav doors (m17, m15)
issues.problem: The lav doors remain the weakest detail. They are flat ash slabs with a seam strip and a handle and lack the occupancy sign and framing detail seen in the photos.
issues.evidence: The lavatory-exterior detail has scored 7.8 for three rounds, and its renders are unchanged.
issues.fix: In 10_mono.js, add the lit VACANT/OCCUPIED indicator plate and the slim aluminium edge trim around the lav door leaf, as on the bar side doors in samchui_render_11.

gapWorth03: Raising the monument ash gain to about 1.6 (std 7-8 at m04) and breaking the tile repeat would lift the bar, the welcome galley and the ash wall to about 8.8. Detailing the J lav doors (indicator plate and edge trim) would lift the lowest detail from 7.8 to about 8.3. Together these would take the area to about 8.7.
